description: This file is a C/C++ header defining APIs and constants for TR-069 device IP download diagnostics, including functions for setting diagnostics state, interface, URL, and QoS parameters. It declares external functions used for managing download diagnostics in a device management framework.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_DownloadDiagnostics_DiagnosticsState
methods.description: Sets the diagnostics state parameter which indicates the progress or result of a download diagnostics test.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_DownloadDiagnostics_Interface
methods.description: Sets the network interface over which the download test is performed.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_DownloadDiagnostics_DownloadURL
methods.description: Sets the URL from which the CPE downloads during diagnostics.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_DownloadDiagnostics_EthernetPriority
methods.description: Sets the Ethernet priority code for marking test packets.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_DownloadDiagnostics_DSCP
methods.description: Sets the DSCP value for marking packets during the diagnostic.
